# chain-verify

> A sample Saluca hash chain, its Ed25519 public key, the chain format, and an independent Python verifier (standard library plus optional `cryptography`) that shares no code with the producer. Apache-2.0.

Facts agents most often get wrong: the default branch is `verify-artifact`, not main. This is a verification kit, not a library and not the producer; the producer is closed source. Blocks are SHA-512 over canonical JSON of {seq, ts, kind, payload, prev_hash} plus one 0x1E byte, signed with Ed25519 over the ASCII hash. The verifier checks signatures against the `--pubkey` file, not against block 0's `operating_pubkey`, and it does not detect blocks removed from the end of a chain (an empty file prints `chain intact`).

## Complete public surface

If a command, option or function is not listed here, it does not exist.

- CLI: `python verify_chain.py <chain.jsonl> [--pubkey <key.pem>]` and `python verify_chain.py --self-test`
- Exit codes: `0` verified (or self-test passed), `2` failed verification or a usage error, `1` self-test failed
- Functions in verify_chain.py: `body_hash(block)`, `load_pubkey(path)`, `verify(blocks, pubkey=None)` returning `(ok, findings)`, `main(argv)`, `self_test()`
- Constants: `GENESIS_ROOT = "hctp-genesis-v1"`, `SEP = b"\x1e"`, `BODY_FIELDS = ("seq", "ts", "kind", "payload", "prev_hash")`
- Data: `sample-chain.jsonl` (5 blocks), `operating-key.pub` (Ed25519 PEM)

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/README.md): how it works (diagram), install, quickstart, what a pass proves, the 2026-10-22 correction note
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/AGENTS.md): orientation, the numbers to trust, test commands

## In depth

- [CHAIN-FORMAT.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/CHAIN-FORMAT.md): the block, hash, genesis and verification rules, enough to write your own verifier

## Verify it yourself

- [verify_chain.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/verify_chain.py): the verifier; `--self-test` proves it can fail
- [sample-chain.jsonl](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/sample-chain.jsonl): five signed sample blocks (invented events)
- [operating-key.pub](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/operating-key.pub): the sample's Ed25519 public key, PEM
- [.github/workflows/verify.yml](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/.github/workflows/verify.yml): CI that verifies the sample and rejects a tampered copy

## Optional

- [draft-ruvalcaba-hctp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ruvalcaba-hctp/): the Internet-Draft that defines the hctp-genesis-v1 seed
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/saluca-labs/chain-verify/blob/verify-artifact/llms-full.txt): README, CHAIN-FORMAT.md and AGENTS.md concatenated
